name: player-fall-damage
comment: WP-2.5a. The player (id 0, no armour) falls 10 blocks onto stone (y 60): EntityPlayer.fall (stat) -> EntityLiving.fall, ceil(distance - 3) through EntityPlayer.attackEntityFrom (no attacker: no difficulty scaling) and damageEntity (getTotalArmorValue 0: 25/25 of the damage, damageRemainder 0). At t 40 set_pos lifts it 10 blocks again (posY = feet + 1.62) for a second fall; difficulty 0 heals 1 every 20 ticks (EntityPlayer.onLivingUpdate's ticksExisted % 20 * 12 == 0).
